exams.notes: Technical and professional subjects prescribed by the board with consent of the Commissioner of Consumer Protection

exams.quote: No person shall receive a license under the provisions of this chapter until such person has passed an examination in such technical and professional subjects as may be prescribed by the board, with the consent of the Commissioner of Consumer Protection.

interval_years.quote: Each licensed architect shall renew his or her license annually.

required.quote: an applicant shall submit proof or attest that he or she has completed twelve hours of continuing professional education during the continuing professional education period.

hours_per_period.quote: completed twelve hours of continuing professional education during the continuing professional education period

period_years.quote: The continuing professional education period shall commence three calendar months prior to the license expiration date and shall run for a period of twelve months from the date of commencement.
